rules.jet: At least two large-R jets with pT >= 200 GeV, |eta| <= 2 and mass in [50,125] GeV. Closest to 80.4 GeV is the alternative and second closest is the edited target. Tie by token index.
rules.mass: Halfway or fully toward 80.4 GeV, with fixed px,py,pz and tag.
rules.pt: Scales all three momentum components by 0.8 or 1.25, recomputes energy at fixed mass, and preserves direction and tag.
rules.matched_tag: Nearest real large-R jet within unit ellipsoid in (log pT, eta, m) using scales (0.15, 0.30, 12 GeV), across distinct split. Increase or decrease the tag by 0.5 to 2.0, neutral difference <=0.05. Restrict all three tag arms to events with matches for all three.
rules.geometry: Highest-tag pT>=200 GeV |eta|<=2 large-R jet with tag>=1 and 80–165 GeV mass is the H proxy. Remaining W proxy is the closest to 80.4 GeV with tag<=0.5, same pT and eta ranges and 50–120 GeV mass. Require nominal absolute interproxy delta phi in [1.1,2.45]. Rotate W proxy only in azimuth by 0.65 rad toward and away from H in distinct edits.
rules.patch: Restore each head's clean pre-output-projection context at all query tokens, or all four heads at block 1. Identity patch restores the corrupted b1h0 context. Track clean-referenced absolute errors and paired error reductions.
rules.scores: W margin = W logit minus maximum of H and none logits. Rank the two candidate jets by this margin. Leptonic verdict = joint W assignment to both the one lepton and one neutrino. Native signal score = 1 - P(background).
rules.statistics: Paired event differences, including zeros. Approximate normal 95% intervals; signed-MC weighted intervals use within-DSID linearized ratio variances and omit singleton strata. Unadjusted intervals for descriptive comparisons. Errors and gains use the identical event for each head.
